plan.title: Liver treated vs control: descriptive DE, no replicates
plan.analytical_narrative: This design has exactly one treated and one control liver sample (0 biological replicates per group). DESeq2 cannot estimate within-group dispersion from n=1 vs n=1, so no p-value from a standard test would have inferential validity. Per the sourced flag (R-0003), the plan runs QC on sample structure, pre-filters low-count genes, normalizes with DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors, and reports DESCRIPTIVE log2 fold changes only (apeglm-shrunk for noise removal) with no hypothesis test and no adjusted p-values. The set of genes with the largest shrunken fold changes is then examined with GO over-representation (not ranked GSEA, which the knowledge check rejected for this situation) using the tested genes as the universe, followed by a report that states the design limitation explicitly and names what would be needed for a valid inferential test (biological replicates within each condition).
